finding: Several perinatal factors were identified as being associated with PTSD symptoms at 1 year postpartum, with instrumental birth, Cesarean section, fundal pressure, and perineal tears increasing the risk, while birth plan adherence, epidural analgesia, and skin-to-skin contact were found to be protective.
mod_finding: Instrumental birth and Cesarean section were identified as risk factors for PTSD symptoms, while having a birth plan respected was found to be protective.
